author: teteumac
body:
Remove the 38 distinct histogram names corresponding to the 47 selected general offline jet DQM entries from JetAnalyzer. Delete their member declarations, bookings, map registrations, lookups and filling code.

  The removal applies to all collections and modes using this analyzer, including PF/CHS, MiniAOD and scouting where these histograms were present. The selected histograms cover trigger and regional kinematics, uncorrected jet area, two barrel BX charged-hadron fractions, energy-fraction profiles versus pT, Jet-ID pass fractions and nine MVA PUJetID
  discriminant distributions.

  Remove the 11 dependent MiniAOD/RECO ratios from DataCertificationJetMET, including their input lookups and member declarations. The three comparison vectors retain 20 aligned entries. Also remove the unused MVA-discriminant input and trigger state used exclusively by the deleted monitoring.

  Jet reconstruction and selection logic are preserved.

  Validation: git diff --check and static source review passed. The removed histogram symbols have no remaining references in the affected classes, retained booking statements are unchanged, and the harvester comparison vectors remain aligned. Compilation, package tests and the DQM/RelVal execution chain were not rerun for this revision.
title: [DQM] Remove selected offline jet DQM histograms and dependent ratios - Round 1
